x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: DotnetDeployer - Deploy .NET projects to NuGet and GitHub

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to deployer.yaml configuration file [default: deployer.yaml]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Simulate deployment without making changes [default: False]

options.name: --package-only
options.description: Generate packages only; do not publish NuGet, GitHub Releases, or GitHub Pages [default: False]

options.name: --package-project
options.description: Project entry from github.packages to package

options.name: --package-target
options.description: Package target in '<type>:<architecture>' form, e.g. exe-setup:x64. Can be repeated.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Directory where generated packages should be written
